# Effective lives of depreciating assets

> One page for each of the 7,430 effective lives in Schedule 2 of the Income Tax Assessment (Effective Life of Depreciating Assets) Determination 2025 (F2025L01097), grouped by Table A industry and Table B asset. This file lists the index and group pages; each group page links its rows.

## Data

- [Effective life tables JSON](https://duguid.com.au/tools/depreciation-rates/effective-life.json): every row of Schedule 2 in the instrument's order.
- [Sitemap of these pages](https://duguid.com.au/tools/depreciation-rates/sitemap.xml): every page, with the date it last changed.
